name: REST controller
description: Adds a REST API controller extending AbstractRESTController from rtcamp/wp-framework. The base extends WP_REST_Controller; the consumer's Rest module instantiates each controller via the Loader.

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the controller class. Default 'Inc\Rest' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace to override.
Directory for the controller file. Default 'includes/Rest'.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Rest'.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Rest'.
Resource slug, kebab- or snake-case, used as the REST route segment, e.g. 'images' for /wp-json/myplugin/v1/images.
PascalCase class name, derived from name.

REST namespace prefix used in the URL path, base only and WITHOUT the version segment, e.g. 'myplugin' (NOT 'myplugin/v1'). The version is added separately from rest_version, so the final route is /wp-json/{rest_namespace}/v{rest_version}/{name}. Passing a version here produces a doubled '/v1/v1'.

wiring.description: Add the controller to the Rest module so the framework Loader registers its routes on rest_api_init. If the Rest module does not exist yet, scaffold it first via `wp-tooling add wp/module --name=Rest --kind=rest`.
